name: Glyphic
author: E. T. Carter
description: A drifting image rendered in characters — each cell a glyph whose density tracks the brightness beneath it, so soft blobs of light resolve into denser symbols while the dark thins to sparse marks. The whole scene re-typed as text-mode art.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: How many character columns fill the frame; low is chunky text, high a fine terminal.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Drift speed of the underlying image the characters trace; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Contrast
params.effect: How sharply brightness maps to glyph density; high makes stark light/dark text.

params.label: Type churn
params.effect: How fast the characters re-roll; 0 freezes the symbols, high keeps retyping.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer brightens the image beneath it; 0 ignores the mouse.
